titulo: What 100 Miles Cost: Gas vs EV, 2020 to Today #shorts
descripcion: Cost to drive 100 miles, gas car (27.2 mpg, EPA) vs EV charged at home (30 kWh/100 mi, EPA): 2020: $7.97 vs $3.94. 2022 (gas at $3.95/gal): $14.53 vs $4.51. Today: $11.39 vs $5.46. Prices: EIA regular gasoline annual averages and residential electricity (2020, 2022, Jan–Aug 2026).
